# AirPlay receiver component

PiperOS Tool includes an AirPlay receiver derived from
`jqssun/android-airplay-server` release `v0.0.31` (commit
`c8defdd70d7e6a04f4f1b71d353653682d594106`). That project is based on
UxPlay and is licensed under GNU GPL version 3.

- Source: https://github.com/jqssun/android-airplay-server/tree/v0.0.31
- Upstream engine: https://github.com/FDH2/UxPlay
- License: see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The ABI libraries under `app/src/main/jniLibs` are the unmodified native
artifacts from the upstream `v0.0.31` release APK. The corresponding source
and build instructions are available at the source link above.
